activity_summary: You sat while he read. An hour and a quarter, the pen in his hand, and the pen did not come down. The office was full of tilt-staves and painted paper for Monday. You saw no mark on the play.

entities.name: Edmund Tilney
entities.context: Read with the pen in his hand and did not use it.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Sat with the fee not yet counted.

entities.name: the lovers' play
entities.context: Mentioned in The pen does not come down
